aggregate_policy: A controlling WARN or BLOCKED gate remains visible; no averaging may hide it. Gates control only their declared lanes unless scope is topic_core.

gates.definition: Book, Section, Topic, and artifact versions/hashes are explicit and stale evidence is superseded.
gates.current_evidence: Alignment verifier passes with boundary and locks the current Book/Section/Topic versions and hashes.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks current-Blueprint coverage claims when hashes drift.

gates.definition: Systematic search, screening, appraisal, contrary evidence, and exact locators are complete.
gates.current_evidence: Provisional synthesis exists; systematic screening and specialist review are incomplete.
gates.claim_effect: Keeps Blueprint provisional and historical claims quarantined.

gates.definition: Every claim has an owner, evidence class, allowed wording, blocked wording, and controlling gates.
gates.current_evidence: Book and Topic V3 claim maps record retain/rewrite/quarantine/transfer decisions.
gates.claim_effect: Prevents law, fiat-causal, peg, policy, and lineage overclaims.

gates.definition: Symbols have one meaning and stocks, flows, shocks, indexes, and physical quantities remain distinct.
gates.current_evidence: Y/W/Kp/H/L/E/X/A/C/M/Cr/T/P/F ontology is locked; R=N+K+I retired.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks reuse of R/N/K/I as a hidden identity.

gates.definition: Every input has provider, URL/DOI, terms, release, local path, coverage, preprocessing, units, and hash.
gates.current_evidence: U.S. macro and several bounded public lanes are source locked; new KLEMS/micro/history/global families remain open.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks affected lane generalization.

gates.definition: Release vintage/as-of date is locked and revisions are not mixed.
gates.current_evidence: Frozen baseline exists; historical real-time and new global vintages are incomplete.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks real-time predictive wording.

gates.definition: Licensed/restricted inputs have explicit access and redistribution terms.
gates.current_evidence: Licensed S&P total return/LBMA or CRSP inputs are absent; Yahoo files remain quarantined.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks asset/peg evidence only.

gates.definition: Units, deflators, PPP, currency, time basis, index base, and physical conversions close.
gates.current_evidence: V3 formula registry closes definitions; literal density/global/legacy infrastructure formula remain open.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks formula or comparison where units do not close.

gates.definition: Construct validity uses genuinely independent operationalizations and reports measurement error/invariance.
gates.current_evidence: Legacy R/N/K/I families overlap and are no longer sufficient for the new ontology.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks construct and predictive promotion.

gates.definition: Coverage is reported by required variable/geography/sector with no silent primary imputation.
gates.current_evidence: U.S. primary panel reports no imputation; global and distributional expansions remain open.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks pooled/global/distributional generalization.

gates.definition: Analysis-ready rows contain every required field; aggregates are excluded; downstream counts and hashes reconcile.
gates.current_evidence: Legacy global artifacts are invalid because complete-case and downstream counts do not reconcile.
gates.claim_effect: Invalidates current global replication evidence.

gates.definition: Transforms/features/selection use only information available at each forecast origin and declared vintage.
gates.current_evidence: Legacy coefficient/sign checks now fit pre-holdout only; real-time revision coverage remains incomplete.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks predictive-candidate wording.

gates.definition: Correctly named metrics and preregistered strong baselines are used.
gates.current_evidence: Corrected rolling-origin RMSE is reported separately from median absolute error; both legacy candidates fail the declared baselines.
gates.claim_effect: No predictive candidate is accepted.

gates.definition: Intervals, dependence, multiple testing, and uncertainty methods match the declared contract.
gates.current_evidence: Circular moving-block resampling now samples with replacement and records seed/block/draws; HAC/cluster and family-wise multiple-testing remain incomplete by lane.
gates.claim_effect: Reported uncertainty remains provisional.

gates.definition: Identification, pre-trends, placebo/negative controls, instrument strength, and two independent designs pass.
gates.current_evidence: Current evidence is descriptive/diagnostic.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks fiat, policy, wage, energy, and market-power causal claims.

gates.definition: Specialist sources, chronology, competing accounts, and uncertainty are appraised.
gates.current_evidence: Firewood/math/zero/Newton-Smith and related claims remain quarantined.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks historical-fact wording; does not block unrelated macro lanes.

gates.definition: Observed payment, invoice, payee/product, inventory, labor, and physical-resource links exist or inference labels are explicit.
gates.current_evidence: Public data provide partial accounting links; L4 tagged ledger is absent.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks specific payer-to-resource claims only.

gates.definition: Privacy, worker rights, legal, ethical, and redistribution review is complete.
gates.current_evidence: Thailand labor design and restricted microdata review are not complete.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks nationality-based labor policy and sensitive publication.

gates.definition: Independent code-path rerun and valid cross-country replication reproduce frozen results.
gates.current_evidence: No independent rerun; legacy global artifacts invalid.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks external validity and Evidence Grade A.

gates.definition: Human formula/data/result/claim review, replication package, limitations, and rights checks are signed.
gates.current_evidence: Internal architecture only.
gates.claim_effect: Blocks Evidence Grade A publication status.
